name: Jarvis - Customer Intelligence and Campaign Agent

parameters.jsCode: return [{json:{agent:'customer_intelligence_campaign',status:'skipped',reason:'No customer intelligence or campaign intent was detected.'}}];

parameters.query: DECLARE @ck int={{Math.max(0,Number($json.customer_key||0))}},@n int={{Math.min(100,Math.max(1,Number($json.top_n||25)))}},@audience bit={{$json.audience_mode?1:0}}; DECLARE @sub nvarchar(100)=N'{{$json.product_subcategory}}',@period varchar(30)='{{$json.purchase_period}}'; WITH a AS(SELECT MAX(d.FullDateAlternateKey) as asofdate FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey=f.OrderDateKey),bounds AS(SELECT asofdate,DATEADD(quarter,DATEDIFF(quarter,0,asofdate)-1,0) prior_q_start,DATEADD(quarter,DATEDIFF(quarter,0,asofdate),0) current_q_start,DATEADD(day,-90,asofdate) day90_start FROM a),m AS(SELECT c.CustomerKey,c.FirstName,MAX(d.FullDateAlternateKey) LastPurchaseDate,DATEDIFF(day,MAX(d.FullDateAlternateKey),b.asofdate) RecencyDays,COUNT(DISTINCT f.SalesOrderNumber) OrderCount,CAST(SUM(f.SalesAmount) AS decimal(19,2)) TotalSpend FROM dbo.DimCustomer c JOIN dbo.FactInternetSales f ON f.CustomerKey=c.CustomerKey JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey=f.OrderDateKey CROSS JOIN bounds b GROUP BY c.CustomerKey,c.FirstName,b.asofdate),fc AS(SELECT CustomerKey,category FROM(SELECT f.CustomerKey,COALESCE(pc.EnglishProductCategoryName,'Uncategorized') category,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY f.CustomerKey ORDER BY SUM(f.SalesAmount) DESC,COALESCE(pc.EnglishProductCategoryName,'Uncategorized')) rn FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey=f.ProductKey LEFT JOIN dbo.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey=p.ProductSubcategoryKey LEFT JOIN dbo.DimProductCategory pc ON pc.ProductCategoryKey=ps.ProductCategoryKey GROUP BY f.CustomerKey,COALESCE(pc.EnglishProductCategoryName,'Uncategorized'))x WHERE rn=1),eligible AS(SELECT DISTINCT f.CustomerKey FROM dbo.FactInternetSales f JOIN dbo.DimDate d ON d.DateKey=f.OrderDateKey JOIN dbo.DimProduct p ON p.ProductKey=f.ProductKey LEFT JOIN dbo.DimProductSubcategory ps ON ps.ProductSubcategoryKey=p.ProductSubcategoryKey CROSS JOIN bounds b WHERE (@sub='' OR ps.EnglishProductSubcategoryName=@sub) AND (@period='all_history' OR (@period='last_completed_quarter' AND d.FullDateAlternateKey>=b.prior_q_start AND d.FullDateAlternateKey<b.current_q_start) OR (@period='last_90_days' AND d.FullDateAlternateKey>=b.day90_start AND d.FullDateAlternateKey<=b.asofdate))) SELECT TOP(@n) m.CustomerKey,m.FirstName,m.LastPurchaseDate,m.RecencyDays,m.OrderCount,m.TotalSpend,fc.category FavoriteCategory,CASE WHEN m.RecencyDays>365 THEN 'At-Risk' WHEN m.TotalSpend>=5000 OR m.OrderCount>=8 THEN 'VIP' ELSE 'Regular' END Segment,CASE WHEN m.RecencyDays>730 THEN 'High' WHEN m.RecencyDays>365 THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Low' END ChurnRisk,CAST(CASE WHEN e.CustomerKey IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS bit) AudienceEligible FROM m LEFT JOIN fc ON fc.CustomerKey=m.CustomerKey LEFT JOIN eligible e ON e.CustomerKey=m.CustomerKey WHERE (@ck=0 OR m.CustomerKey=@ck) AND (@audience=0 OR e.CustomerKey IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.RecencyDays>730 THEN 1 WHEN m.RecencyDays>365 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END,m.TotalSpend DESC;

parameters.jsCode: const text=($json.output||[]).flatMap(i=>i.content||[]).find(c=>c.type==='output_text')?.text; if(!text) throw new Error('Customer agent returned no output_text'); const result=JSON.parse(text); const prior=$('Build Customer Analysis').first().json; return [{json:{agent:'customer_intelligence_campaign',status:'completed',actions:prior.actions,summary:result.summary,audience_description:result.audience_description,email_drafts:result.email_drafts,human_approval_required:result.email_drafts.length>0,data:prior.data}}];
